name: Directus
description: An Instant App & API for your SQL Database. Directus wraps your new or existing SQL database with a realtime GraphQL+REST API for developers, and an intuitive admin app for non-technical users.

paths.name: App Data/Uploads
paths.description: Container Path: /directus/uploads/ This is where your files get stored you upload to and manage within Directus

variables.name: Admin Email
variables.description: The Direcuts Admin User Account. Feel free to change this to your email address.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: The Direcuts Admin User Account. Feel free to pass your desired password here, otherwise a default password will be generated on first launch. (check logs!)

variables.name: Database
variables.description: What database client to use. One of pg or postgres, mysql, oracledb, mssql, or sqlite3.

variables.name: Database Host
variables.description: Database host. Required when using pg, mysql, oracledb, or mssql.

variables.name: Database Port
variables.description: Database port. Required when using pg, mysql, oracledb, or mssql.

variables.name: Database Name
variables.description: Database name. Required when using pg, mysql, oracledb, or mssql.

variables.name: Database User
variables.description: Database user. Required when using pg, mysql, oracledb, or mssql.

variables.name: Database Password
variables.description: Database user's password. Required when using pg, mysql, oracledb, or mssql.

variables.name: Database Filename
variables.description: Where to read/write the SQLite database. Required when using sqlite3.

variables.name: Postgres Connection String
variables.description: When using pg, you can submit a connection string instead of individual properties. Using this will ignore any of the other connection settings.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Set your Time Zone here (e.g. Europe/Berlin)
